content: 酒店接会议团队，为什么不能只看团房收入？
【示例场景，仅用于说明问题，不代表行业均值或某家酒店的真实数据】销售拿回一份会议团队询价单：团房一百二十间夜，会场一天，餐饮三场，合同总额看上去相当可观。接不接往往在十分钟内决定，依据基本只有一个：团房收入够不够大。
这样的决定可能在几个月后变成遗憾。团队压在高需求日期，房价被锁在团队价；会场和早餐在同一时段拥堵；账期拉长，尾款还可能因服务争议被扣。团房收入没少，酒店却比不接更不赚钱。
签下一笔会议团队，不等于创造正收益。真正要判断的是：酒店交换出去什么，又拿回来了什么。
第一笔损失是被替代的散客收益。团队占用高需求日期，本来可以按更高价格卖给散客、会员或协议客，这个差额不会出现在收入表上，而是以没有发生的形式消失。
第二笔损失是接待能力冲突。会场、早餐、餐位、行李、集中退房和接驳会在同一时段叠加，基础服务被多个需求同时拉扯，散客体验首先受伤。
第三笔是净贡献失真。团房、会场、餐饮、设备、免房、加班和第三方服务常被打包成一个总数字，佣金、食材、临时用工、免房和补偿却没有被逐项扣除。
第四笔是现金与取消条件。定金、账期、缩减房量、取消责任和尾款条件，决定收入是及时到账、被拖延，还是变成应收风险。合同额和可收回现金不是一回事。
接单前至少填四张表。第一张是被替代散客收入表，比较团队价净房费、预期散客净收益和会员协议客被挤出的影响。第二张是接待能力冲突表，按小时列出会场、早餐、前台、行李、客房、工程和接驳的峰值需求与剩余容量。
第三张是团队净贡献表，把团房、会场、餐饮和其他收入分开，再扣除佣金、食材、设备、外包、额外工时、免房、补偿和税费。第四张是合同与现金条件表，写清保留日期、名单截止、缩减取消、定金尾款、开票和签字权限。
四张表填完，结论不只有接或不接：可以直接接受，也可以改日期、房量、餐饮时段、最低消费或付款条款后接受；证据不足时小规模试接；资源冲突、净贡献或回款条件不成立时拒绝或转介。
最低成本的验证方式，是选一个日期、一种团队规模和一个会议产品做模拟，一次只改变一个变量。再复盘过去三场已结束的团队，重新填四张表，检查本店最常犯的判断错误。
团队生意本质上是资源交换。只有把高需求房量、会场餐位、服务注意力和现金风险，与净贡献、现金回款、可复用客源和品牌价值放在同一张桌上，团房收入才有经营意义。
contentEn: Why a Meeting-Group Contract Is Not the Same as a Profitable Booking

An illustrative scenario only, not an industry average or any property's actual figures. A sales manager brings back a meeting enquiry: 120 room nights, one day of function space and three meal functions. The headline number looks strong, so the decision is reduced to one question: is the group revenue big enough?

Months later, the group dates may land on the most expensive weekends, the rate is locked at the group price, breakfast and function space collide, and payment terms stretch. Group revenue is on plan, but the hotel is less profitable than if it had declined the business.
A signed meeting-group contract is not the same as a positive return. The real question is what the hotel gives up and what it gets back.

The first hidden loss is displaced transient value. Group rooms may occupy dates that could have sold at a higher rate to transient guests, members or corporate accounts. That gap disappears from the report because it never happens.

The second is capacity conflict. Function space, breakfast, restaurant covers, luggage, a single checkout wave and transfers draw on the same service base at the same time. Transient guests feel the strain first.

The third is distorted net contribution. Bundled group quotes hide commissions, food cost, temporary labour, complimentary rooms, equipment, overtime and compensation. Headline revenue is not contribution.

The fourth is cash and cancellation risk. Deposits, payment periods, room-block reductions, cancellation liability and final-invoice terms determine whether revenue arrives on time or becomes receivable risk.
Before committing, complete four tables: displaced transient revenue; hourly capacity conflict; net contribution by revenue and cost line; and contract and cash terms with decision rights.
The outcome is not simply take or leave. Accept, revise the terms, run a limited trial when evidence is thin, or decline and refer when contribution, capacity or cash conditions do not hold.

Test the method with one date, one group size and one meeting product. Change one variable at a time, then refill the four tables for the last three completed groups to identify the property's repeated judgement error.

Meeting business is a resource exchange. Put displaced room value, capacity, service attention and cash risk beside contribution, collection, reusable demand and brand value before calling group revenue good business.
